subject: Vendr onboarding: request to provision corporate profile & CAIQ evidence
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Acme Analytics <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile request: Redwood Inference (CAIQ + SOC2 evidence)

Hi Soojin,

I work with Acme Analytics on vendor intake and they asked us to get Redwood set up in Vendr so their security team can review the CAIQ answers and supporting evidence. Can you do the following?

- Create a vendor profile for "Redwood Inference" in Vendr (org slug attached).
- Upload SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) and any CAIQ mapping.
- Add a primary contact (name/email) and an API key if you want us to pull answers automatically.

If you'd rather provide the CAIQ spreadsheet directly, attach it to this thread and we'll import. The timeline from Acme is tight (they need access by EOD Tues 8/24).

Portal link: https://app.vendr.com/orgs/redwood-inference/profile

Thanks — let me know if you want us to provision the account and send an invite.

Best,
Alice Turner
Vendr Onboarding
onboarding@vendr.com

[Attachment: vendr-invite-template.txt]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@vendr.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile request: Redwood Inference (CAIQ + SOC2 evidence)

Alice — thanks for the heads up. I can take point on this. A few clarifying notes before I upload:

1) We can upload the SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf) but we prefer that the document be marked as restricted to vendor reviewers only (no public link). Can you confirm Vendr will honor a restricted visibility flag?

2) For the CAIQ, we maintain an internal mapping sheet (attached: CAIQ_mapping_sheet.xlsx). Would Vendr import that directly or is there a canonical CAIQ template you prefer?

3) API keys: we'd rather share a read-only integration key scoped to answers only. Please send the instructions (token format and where to enter it in the UI) so I can provision it with minimal scope.

Timeline: we can upload the docs today. If Acme must have access by EOD 8/24, confirm that a profile created today with attachments will be visible to their reviewers.

Attaching SOC 2 and CAIQ mapping now.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

[Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2025.pdf; CAIQ_mapping_sheet.xlsx]

From: Alice Turner <alice.turner@vendr.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: Acme Analytics <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile request: Redwood Inference (CAIQ + SOC2 evidence)

Hi Soojin — thanks, that's perfect. Short answers to your questions: 

- Visibility: yes, Vendr supports "Reviewer-only" access. When you upload the report, choose "Restricted: Reviewers only" and we'll ensure the Acme security group can access it.

- CAIQ import: we can import either your mapping sheet or the standard CAIQ CSV. If you send the mapping (looks good from a quick glance), we'll map columns to the CAIQ fields and flag any missing evidence.

- API key instructions: log in > Organization settings > Integrations > Create API key (choose scope: answers.read). We'll accept any standard bearer token. If you prefer, I can create a provisioning ticket and generate the key for you — we'd email it to sec-ops@redwood.ai and you can rotate after import.

Next steps I will take now: create the Redwood profile, invite marissa_cole@redwood.ai as org admin, and import the CAIQ mapping. Expect a confirmation message with the import report and any missing evidence list.

I'll also tag the SOC 2 PDF as "Reviewer-only" per your request.

—Alice
Vendr Onboarding

[Generated link: https://app.vendr.com/imports/IMP-58231]

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Alice Turner <alice.turner@vendr.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, Acme Analytics <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr profile request: Redwood Inference (CAIQ + SOC2 evidence)

Alice — appreciate the fast turnaround. I validated access this afternoon and confirmed Acme's reviewers can see the profile and the SOC 2 PDF in "Reviewer-only" mode. A couple of housekeeping items: 

- Import report: Vendr flagged three CAIQ questions where evidence is missing (controls 6.2.4, 9.1.1, 11.3.2). I've assigned owners in the mapping sheet and updated the expected delivery dates.

- API key: please provision the read-only key and send it to sec-ops@redwood.ai. We'll rotate it after the initial sync.

- Audit note: record the import ticket ID (IMP-58231) in our compliance tracker; Marissa will attach the import report to the ACME deal in HubSpot (deal ACME-2026-RED-011).

Thanks again — this meets Acme's timeline. I'll follow up once owners provide the three missing artifacts.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
